content.short: Gelato provides a decentralized Web3 backend to automate smart contracts and support off-chain tooling.
content.description: Gelato is an all-in-one Ethereum Rollup-as-a-Service platform built without limits. Designed for speed, security, and scalability, it enables anyone to build and deploy fully serviced Layer 2 chains. Gelato rollups integrate with Web3 tools and services to provide a production-ready Web3 development environment from the Genesis block, aligning development workflows with the broader Web3 ecosystem. This approach emphasizes speed, security, and scalable growth for projects seeking to deploy Layer 2 solutions.
content.meta: Gelato is an all-in-one Ethereum Rollup-as-a-Service (RaaS) platform built without limits. Discover Gelato and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Introducing Gelato Turbo: High-Performance Sequencing for Rollups
resources.tldr: The sequencer decides ordering and latency, which makes it the most consequential and least discussed part of a rollup. On building one for throughput without losing reliability.

resources.title: Turbo Relayer: Faster Transactions, Lower Gas Overhead
resources.tldr: Sub-300ms gasless confirmations by way of EIP-7702 and ERC-4337. Useful for seeing where the overhead in account abstraction actually accumulates.

resources.title: Fee Collector: Automatically Aggregate Protocol Fees Into USDC
resources.tldr: Protocols accrue fees in dozens of tokens and then have to do something about it. A small, practical piece on turning that scatter into one denominated balance.
